stem.text: But-2-ene reacts with cold dilute acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ to give product X.
But-2-ene reacts with hot concentrated acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ to give product Y.
Which statement about product X and product Y is correct?

A.text: Both product X and product Y will react with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine.

B.text: Neither product X nor product Y will react with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine.

C.text: Product X will react with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine, product Y will not.

D.text: Product Y will react with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine, product X will not.
